newsitem.title: UK: Russia's SUN Brewing Q2 net income $1.38 mln.
newsitem.headline: Russia's SUN Brewing Q2 net income $1.38 mln.

text.p: Russia's SUN Brewing Ltd net income was $1.38 million in the second quarter of 1996 ended June 30, on sales of $58.8 million, SUN said in a statement on Tuesday.
SUN's earnings have been restated to U.S. GAAP standards, so no comparison was available.
The Russian brewer's net income for the first six months of the year was $1.25 million and sales in the first half were $92.252 million, against $108.6 million for the whole of 1995.
Gross operating margins rose to 11.5 percent in the first half of 1996 from 10.5 percent in 1995 and operating margins rose to 7.2 percent from 5.4 percent .
Earnings per share rose to 10 cents in the first half of 1996 from three cents for the whole of 1995.

SUN, founded in 1993, owns controlling interests in five Russian companies operating breweries in Perm, Ivanovo, Kursk, Saransk and Yekaterinburg and is traded in global depositary receipt (GDR) form in Luxembourg.
